name: Sweet Serenity
label: Quest
description: Sweet Serenity: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.
Understand this: Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.

clips.title: Completion
paras: May you bash in many a brain, friend!
